remarks: Timeless Elegance Meets Modern Living in Westport's Premier Location.  Step into a piece of history, seamlessly blended with contemporary comfort, in this stunning 1931 Frazier Peters stone house. Set atop Charcoal Hill that impresses from first approach, this charming residence with pool and cascading waterfall is situated on a coveted 1.8-acre private oasis in Westport, Connecticut. This 3,900 square foot residence offers a rare combination of classic charm and modern amenities.  Nestled within one of Westport's most desirable neighborhoods, this property boasts unparalleled access to top-rated schools, including the renowned Staples High School.  This meticulously expanded home preserves the architectural integrity of its original design while catering to the needs of modern living. The spacious interiors flow effortlessly, creating an inviting atmosphere for both relaxation and entertaining.  Enjoy the ultimate outdoor lifestyle with expansive patio areas perfect for al fresco dining, and a delightful screened-in porch overlooking pool and bluestone patio ideal for enjoying peaceful evenings. The lush, mature landscaping provides exceptional privacy, creating a tranquil retreat.  A versatile detached space, accessible under roof and just steps from the main house, currently serves as a comfortable home office and hangout area.
